notes: Current and archived file open/download actions use the shared accessible SVG registry.
Archive permanent-delete controls retain the existing administrator-only data-role and backend permission contract.
Stage 7.1.3 filename spacing and current-file action controls remain in place.
Business logic for upload, replacement, archives, locks, save and rollback is unchanged.

Stage 7.1.4.5 renders replacement as a real SVG path whose outline is derived from the U+21BB clockwise open circle arrow glyph. It contains one clockwise arrow only, with no SVG text and no alternate arrow symbol.
Stage 7.1.4.5 restores the exact previously approved U+21BB-derived SVG silhouette and reduces only its thickness with a 0.30 SVG morphology erosion.
Stage 7.2.1 blocks all popup checklist mutations until both the edit session and the current checklist lock are active.
Stage 7.2.1 captures the active session ID in immutable upload and replacement task contexts and asks the backend to reject sessionless frontend mutations.
Stage 7.2.1.2 uses the edit-session heartbeat as the single backend heartbeat; it already renews all session locks.
Stage 7.2.1.2 releases clean stage locks on navigation but retains locks for stages mutated by the active session.
Stage 7.2.1.2 removes the zero-delay stage Yandex folder retry loop and treats yandexDisabled as a terminal local-only state.
Stage 7.2.1.3 permits full edit-session rollback only for the explicitly confirmed Cancel button action.
Stage 7.2.1.3 auto-commits active sessions on application restart and expired sessions on heartbeat timeout; these lifecycle events never delete uploaded files or restore an old snapshot.
Stage 7.2.1.3 queues a commit beacon on popup, iframe, tab or browser close; Cancel suppresses this autosave because it follows the explicit rollback flow.
Stage 7.2.1.3 recovers interrupted rollback only when its recorded close reason is cancel_button; legacy non-explicit rollback transitions are converted to commit recovery.

Stage 7.2.3 preserves the global limit of nine concurrent uploads and serializes the backend read-modify-write mutation for each checklist item so concurrent files cannot overwrite one another in the checklist JSON.
Stage 7.2.3 throttles progress rendering, debug requests and cross-window upload snapshots so large selections do not saturate the browser or local API.
Stage 7.2.3 retries transient network, HTTP and edit-session reconnect failures without draining the remaining in-memory file queue.
Stage 7.2.3 waits for the upload queue before Save or confirmed Cancel and warns before closing a window with pending local files.
Stage 7.2.4 finalizes Save and unload through one idempotent /api/checklist/session/finalize request.
Stage 7.2.4 order is upload queue idle, local checklist persistence, edit-session commit and lock release, external jobs and Bitrix summary delivery, then popup close.
Stage 7.2.4 stores finalization and message delivery status by session_id so repeated close events do not send a second Bitrix summary.
Stage 7.2.4 defers replacement summaries until the common committed session summary and keeps rollback exclusive to confirmed Cancel.
Stage 8.2 separates local folderPath/folderUrl from Yandex folder metadata.
Stage 8.2 exposes queued/running/ready/error/disabled folder states and manual retry in the popup.
Stage 8.2 prepares pending create_item_folder retargeting so a future rename creates only the final folder name.
Stage 8.2.1 always renders the current-stage Yandex folder control and disables it when no public folder URL is available.
Stage 8.2.1 shows an item Yandex action only after at least one current document exists, including custom items.
Stage 8.2.1 keeps item Yandex controls visible but disabled when the current stage has no Yandex connection, while hidden empty custom items continue background job polling through the state marker.
Stage 8.2.1 applies the same visible-disabled rule to the Yandex action inside the item folder window.
Stage 8.3 adds transactional item renaming with automatic conflict suffixes and a shared rename action for standard and custom items.
Stage 8.3.1 replaces the separate rename icon and browser prompt with one-click inline editing of the item name; blur or Enter validates and saves, Escape cancels the local editor.

Stage 8.4 adds shared transactional drag-and-drop ordering across groups of one checklist stage, including the Not Required group, with order-version conflict protection and deferred Yandex folder moves.
Stage 8.4.1 replaces the static drag source with a floating name-only preview, collapses the source row during dragging, restores near-origin drops, and softens the vertical drag marker.
Stage 8.4.2 removes the visible Status column and controls Нет, Есть and Не требуется through the enlarged interactive circle beside each item name.
Stage 8.4.2 preserves hidden dates and the previous group while an item is in Не требуется; drag never deletes files, while the status-circle restore follows file-delete permissions and confirmation.
Stage 8.4.2 throttles drag target updates with requestAnimationFrame, midpoint hysteresis, target settling and FLIP row animations to prevent placeholder flicker.
Stage 8.4.2 hides local-only and unavailable-Yandex explanatory labels while retaining disabled Yandex controls and operational queue/error states.
Stage 8.4.3 keeps date values in backend data but removes every popup date toggle, date header and date input from the frontend.
Stage 8.4.3 transfers 33 percent of the previous item-name column width to the document column in fixed and responsive layouts.
Stage 8.8 enables the notification bell for current files and opens one shared notification-draft editor from the popup.
Stage 8.8 keeps employee/CRM lookup out of the frontend contract: internal recipient fields are manual until stages 8.10-8.12.
Stage 8.8 creates, edits and cancels session-bound drafts through the stage 8.7 backend without sending Bitrix messages or tasks.
Stage 8.9 loads the global assignment-part dictionary in the shared notification draft interface.
A typed value that does not match an existing entry is added atomically when the draft is saved.
Stage 8.10 loads the shared Bitrix employee picker before notification-draft-ui.js.
Employee search uses the server-side bitrix_users_cache and retains manual ID/name fallback when Bitrix is unavailable.
Stage 8.11 adds a shared external-contractor picker backed by local and Bitrix SUPPLIER company caches.
New external contractors are stored locally with deterministic phone, email and title deduplication; CRM synchronization is deferred until a committed delivery flow invokes it.
Stage 8.12 resolves the project object responsible user as curator for external recipients and retains manual fallback.
Stage 8.14 displays the ten most recent document assignments by stable seriesId in popup document rows.
Stage 8.15 adds explicit manual retry controls for failed/blocked CRM, task and chat deliveries while preserving successful operations through existing idempotency keys.
Bitrix hotfix 8.15.1 resumes stale same-user sessions, makes Save and Close return after durable local commit, hides non-error Yandex status labels and temporarily disables notification bells.
8.15.3: Bitrix host-cross close callback and compact idempotent unload finalization.
Stage 8.15.4 separates the ID Not Required group into its own card with the same 14px spacing used by configured P/R panels.
Stage 8.15.4 tracks real popup and folder interactions, warns after 24 minutes, and runs the same durable finalize flow as Save and Close after 25 minutes.
Stage 8.15.4 sends lastActivityAt through the edit-session heartbeat and accepts an idempotent server-side inactivity finalization fallback.
Stage 8.15.4 startup reconciliation restores only current local documents without duplicating synced, queued or running Yandex upload jobs.
Stage 8.15.5 exposes ChecklistPopupNavigation so item-folder return always restores the originating checklist stage and scrolls to the exact item.
Stage 8.15.6 adds conflict-aware custom-folder recovery, bounded Yandex lock retry and separate folder/file error controls.
Stage 8.15.7 adds the labeled public-folder share control and drag-and-drop upload targets without exposing file deletion to public-link visitors.
Stage 8.15.7.1 restores icon-only download controls for current and archived item-folder files and uses one upward arrow touching a top line.
Stage 8.15.8 keeps files in a local pre-upload area until the user presses the explicit Upload confirmation button.
The popup upload area expands above the remaining item actions and grows by file-card rows.
The public-link action is icon-only and disabled in the application interface while its backend remains unchanged.
Archive rows display the preserved original uploader and upload time rather than the later replacement actor and archive time.
Stage 8.15.9.5 resolves the popup Yandex action from durable backend jobs before opening a folder or starting manual recovery.
Popup host diagnostics records launcher, application-frame and popup lifecycle state without changing open, close, resize, save or synchronization behavior.
Stage 8.16 adds one level of subitems (Todoist-like): nested rows, sibling-unique names, derived parent status, subfolders inside the parent Yandex folder, subfolder list on the item folder page.
Stage 8.16 hides the share and notification buttons and records only essential popup diagnostics.
Stage 8.16.2 adds the Design checklist and optional explicit popup columns (panelGroupIds).
Stage 8.17 uploads whole folders: a folder dropped into an item becomes a subitem, deeper levels become folders of the subitem; empty folders are kept.
lineEndingNote: Hashes are calculated from bytes written to disk. This is stable for Windows CRLF and Unix LF.
